thread:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT ALERT — p99 latency spike for PulsarEdge (single-tenant) detected in us-west-2. Current p99: 2.3s (SLO 500ms). Auto-page to oncall.
Taylor (oncall): seeing it, joining. Any severity classification?
pagerbot: Impact: degraded response times on streaming and non-streaming endpoints for PulsarEdge. Error rate stable. Rule fired: p99 > 1.0s for 5m.
Taylor (oncall): tagging eng-runtime and SRE. @Ellie @Mohit can you eyeball?
Mohit (sre): I'm on it. First glance: high concurrency from pulsaredge-prod tenant, sudden fanout of 6x typical QPS ~08:45 UTC. Streaming stalls: many sessions reporting delayed token emission at tail.
Jamie (support): Customer reported UI stalls at 08:44, they started throttling but still seeing long tails. They sent a few example prompts, odd prefixes with embedded NULs and weird control chars. Pasting sanitized sample: `"\x00START\ngenerate summary of..."`
Ingest-Bot: New ingestion event: 1759990000 - 1759990055 : pulsaredge-prod — 4200 req/min (baseline 700).
Taylor (oncall): ok hypothesis: prompt noise causing KV cache churn or tokenizer fallback? Any quick dashboards?
Ellie (eng-runtime): pulling traces. `curl -s "https://console.internal/metrics?pulsaredge&range=15m"` gave spike on kv_cache_evictions and model_cpu_ms. Snippet: ```time,kv_evictions,model_cpu_ms
08:40,12,180
08:44,125,1320
08:46,230,2100
```
Mohit (sre): looks like KV cache key mismatch — multiple slightly different prefixes -> cache misses -> heavier compute. Also seeing many tiny sessions being kept open -> multiplexing inefficiency.
Taylor (oncall): can we triage severity: Customer-facing? SLA at 99.5% p99 500ms. This is SLO breach.
Jamie (support): Yes customer UX degraded, multiple users complaining. They asked if we can reroute to fallback model.
Ellie (eng-runtime): Quick mitigations: 1) enable request-normalization to strip control chars for PulsarEdge route (config toggle), 2) route new requests to region fallback pool with relaxed batching, 3) temporarily pin to a larger instance type for their dedicated pool. I can push normalization and routing change.
Taylor (oncall): Do it. Prioritize normalization first. What risk?
Ellie (eng-runtime): low-risk text sanitizer at gateway will drop NULs and collapse repeated whitespace, keeps tokens same for majority. Rolling to 10% can be done in 60s.
Mohit (sre): I'll increase connection timeouts to avoid session pileups, and drop keep-alive for tiny sessions. That should reduce multiplex overhead.
Taylor (oncall): Ellie, start 10% -> 100% if metrics look good. Mohit, make changes and monitor.
Ellie (eng-runtime): rolling 10% now. `PATCH /config/routes/pulsaredge` applied.
Mohit (sre): adjusting keep-alive and session gc. `kubectl patch deploy streaming-proxy -n pulsaredge --patch '{"spec":...}'` — applied.
Ellie (eng-runtime): 08:50 monitoring: p99 dropped from 2.3s -> 1.1s at 10% normalization, kv_evictions halving.
Taylor (oncall): good sign. Increase to 50% then 100% if stable.
Ellie (eng-runtime): moving to 50%.
Jamie (support): Customer acknowledged and reports improved responsiveness on new sessions.
Ingest-Bot: Traffic alert — QPS reduced to 1800 req/min after client-side throttling.
Mohit (sre): session gc changes reduced open streams count by ~40%. Still some spikes at tails for long-prefix prompts.
Ellie (eng-runtime): Normalization at 100% now. p95 = 220ms, p99 = 480ms — back under SLO. Logging shows prompt keys normalized to consistent prefixes; KV cache reuse improved.
Taylor (oncall): Marking immediate mitigation successful. Leaving actions: postmortem, follow-up with PulsarEdge on why NUL/control chars present, consider adding upstream validation + rate-limit for repeated identical session prefixes.
Mohit (sre): Creating incident ticket IR-1759990001. Assigning to eng-runtime for deeper root cause.
Jamie (support): I've notified customer with interim notes and suggested they patch client to sanitize inputs. They want a RCA.
Ellie (eng-runtime): Quick root-cause hypothesis: client-side bug sending binary payload into text field causing tokenizer to produce divergent tokenization and KV key proliferation. Will collect sample prompts and tokenization diffs.
Taylor (oncall): On-call handoff: I'm toggling badge to oncall->next in 10m. Ellie's staying on for RCA. Mohit will produce SLO impact metrics.
pagerbot: Incident annotated: severity: sev2, timeline started 1759990001. Tags: kv-cache, tokenizer, single-tenant, streaming.
Taylor (oncall): final notes — create postmortem, include metrics: cumulative p99 breach duration ~12m, estimated customer impact: degraded UX for ~700 users. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
Ellie (eng-runtime): Will grab tokenization trace export and put in /incidents/1759990001/artifacts.
Mohit (sre): I'll prepare mitigation runbook to auto-enable normalization if p99>750ms for >3m on single-tenant bursts.
Jamie (support): Closing customer loop: scheduled follow-up call for tomorrow 14:00 UTC.
Taylor (oncall): OK closing out active ops. Postmortem owners: Ellie (eng-runtime), Mohit (sre), Jamie (support).
pagerbot: Incident status: mitigated.
